message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: Defendant set fire to a house belonging to three brothers, causing property damage. No serious consequences (no death). This is arson (放火). In Chinese criminal law, article 132 (or 115?) Actually arson is under article 132 (dangerous arson) maybe. The examples: For fire cases, they gave answer "放火" or "失火". In earlier examples: For Wu case (arson) they answered "放火". For Guo case (fire due to welding) they answered "失火". The difference: "放火" is intentional arson; "失火" is accidental fire due to negligence. Here it's intentional, so "放火". Also maybe "危害公共安全罪" but they usually just list "放火". So answer: [罪名]放火<eoa>
